extName.description: Extension name, shown in the browser's extension list and store. 75 characters at most.

extShortName.description: Short extension name. Keep the brand name.

extDescription.message: X'in linklerini ispiyonlamasına son ver. Kopyaladığın veya paylaştığın X (Twitter) linklerindeki takibi (?s=, t=, a=) siler.
extDescription.description: Extension description, shown in the browser's extension list and store. 132 characters at most.

htmlLang.description: Language code of this translation (BCP 47, for example en or tr). Used as the popup's lang attribute.

toggleTitle.description: Tooltip of the on/off switch in the popup.

enabledLabel.description: Screen-reader label of the on/off switch in the popup.

countLabelOne.description: Shown next to the counter when exactly one link has been cleaned (1 link unsnitched).

countLabelMany.description: Shown next to the counter for any other number of cleaned links (0 or 25 links unsnitched). Use the same text as the singular if your language doesn't need a plural.

statusOn.description: Popup status while Unsnitch is on.

statusOff.description: Popup status while Unsnitch is switched off.

pasteLabel.description: Label of the text box where you paste links to clean.

cleanButton.description: Button that cleans the pasted text and copies the result.

feedbackEmpty.description: Feedback when the text box is empty and the button is pressed.

feedbackCleanedCopied.description: Feedback after the pasted links were cleaned and the result was copied.

feedbackAlreadyCleanCopied.description: Feedback when nothing needed cleaning, and the text was copied.

feedbackCleanedManual.description: Feedback when the links were cleaned but the browser did not allow copying.

feedbackAlreadyClean.description: Feedback when nothing needed cleaning and the browser did not allow copying.

starOnGithub.description: Footer link to the GitHub repository. Keep the star.

coffee.description: Footer link to the maintainer's Buy Me a Coffee page. Keep it short and keep the cup.

copyCleanLink.description: Right-click menu item on links on X.
